column1: # z23-wallet size budget, read by `make check-z23-wallet-size`.
# key = <cc -dumpmachine>[-ucrt]-<gcc|clang><major>: sizes compare only on the
# toolchain that set them; any other toolchain is reported, not failed.
# "budget" is the release binary's file-size limit in bytes; every other row is
# a section's file bytes in the reference build the budget was set from, so a
# failure can say which sections grew.
# Reference: the integrated wallet (every page) of 2026-11-24 built with the
# release profile: 434,707 bytes on Windows (the integrator's tree) and 400,344
